dct_title_s: Thailand Earthquakes: Damage Proxy Maps, Mar 2025
dct_description_sm: # Thailand Earthquakes: Damage Proxy Maps, Mar 2025 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Thailand Earthquakes (Mar 2025) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Chiang Mai, Thailand, Earthquakes, 29 Mar 2025, v0.9 ** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Bangkok, Thailand, Earthquakes, 29 Mar 2025, v0.9 ** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Chiang Rai, Thailand, Earthquakes, 29 Mar 2025, v0.7 ** (superseded) **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2024-2025)
